theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_idx_crt_row_card
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], let P : ℕ → Type := fun n => Quot (fun v w : {v : ZMod (n) × ZMod (n) // ∃ x y : ZMod (n), x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : (ZMod (n))ˣ, (u : ZMod (n)) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : ZMod (n)) * v.1.2 = w.1.2); Nat.card (P N) = N.primeFactors.prod (fun p => Nat.card (P (p ^ N.factorization p)))
theorems.natural_summary: Composes the CRT ring equivalence with the accepted ring-transport and finite-product row-quotient equivalences, then applies cardinality preservation and the finite-product cardinality formula.
